PhysVal review complete at `2bd57912350e9e88b1918e0221b205153545346e`. I found no blocker for a draft PR.

I independently compared the fresh LAYOUT-001 export with the retained stock compact. Removing only the new envelopes left both ECAL detector XML subtrees identical, including all 2,352 replica declarations. The integrated materials file and both readout definitions were also byte-identical. The implementation preserves the barrel and mirrored endcap transforms and retains the legacy path for compacts without an envelope.

The earlier benchmark supports the measured ECAL-only startup improvement. Geometry navigation gains air-to-air boundaries, which can change Geant4 stepping and random-number consumption. Material rays, identifier comparisons, and electron smoke tests establish geometry and transport functionality. Shower-response equivalence requires a dedicated comparison.

I ran `git diff --check` and the independent XML comparisons. No files changed or simulations launched. The fresh tracker-plus-ECAL overlap scan and native volume-manager checks remain the coordinator’s integration gates.
